interface.title: ConText (powered by Conc)
interface.stage_of_work: exploratory analysis of a built text corpus
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser concordancer where a researcher moves from keyword (keyness) and frequency lists to concordance lines, clusters, collocates and a dispersion plot for a search term, then down to the full source text with the match highlighted.

data.note: Two demo corpora were already built on the server: sample_corpus (6 speeches on autonomous weapons, 378 word tokens) and sample_reference_corpus (6 local-news articles, 313 word tokens). Both were picked from the Settings dropdowns on '/'. Nothing was uploaded.

tree.specific: Explore sample_corpus against sample_reference_corpus with keywords, concordance, clusters, collocates and full texts

features.name: Target vs reference corpus selector with keyness table

features.specific: Choose Selected Corpus and Reference Corpus in ConText Settings; the Keywords report lists tokens with frequency, document frequency, normalized frequency, relative risk, log ratio and log likelihood, filtered by minimum document frequency

choose target corpus
choose reference corpus
close panel to recompute the Keywords table

List words that are unusually frequent compared with the reference

features.name: Keyword-in-context concordance with neighbour-based sort
features.general: Search a term or phrase, list every hit centred with left/right context, and reorder hits by the words at chosen positions around it, with paging

page through the lines
read the totals

features.name: Sort-linked n-gram clusters panel

features.specific: Clusters panel: n-gram length 2–3, token position left/right/around set by the Order dropdown, punctuation n-grams excluded, paged

screens_never_reached: Concordance-line → full text via the Node hyperlink: the Node cells render as escaped HTML text ('<span class="context-clickable" … hx-get="/text/…">'), not as live links. Clicking a row only highlighted it (screens/010.webp). The full text could only be opened from the Concordance Plot.

Cluster / keyword / frequency token → query hyperlinks: these also render as escaped HTML text (screens/007.webp, screens/009.webp, screens/030.webp). Opening /query-context/… directly returns a blank HTMX fragment (screens/025.webp), so I re-ran each term from the search box instead.
Keywords, Collocates, Clusters and Concordance Plot settings panels: each says only 'Coming soon!' (screens/005.webp, screens/013.webp, screens/024.webp, screens/039.webp).
not_done: Keyword rows for sample_corpus vs sample_reference_corpus: the footer says 'Keywords: 1' but no row is shown in the table (screens/004.webp). The reverse comparison does show its row (screens/030.webp).

Clicking a concordance line to open the source text, the drill-through the README describes, does not work in this build because of the escaped-HTML links. The same result was reached through the plot instead.
Clicking a cluster to narrow the view to that sequence, as the README describes, does not work because the cluster links are escaped HTML; the sequence was searched as a phrase instead (n1/t9).
Collocate tokens are not clickable (screens/035.webp), so I could not drill from a collocate to its concordance.
Changing collocation window, minimum frequency, n-gram length or keyness filters: there are no controls for these yet ('Coming soon').
Bug found on replay: 'this' is listed twice in the Frequencies list, at rank 9 and rank 14 (freq 5, docs 4 both times).

Bug found on replay: after swapping the corpora, the Reference Corpus summary still names sample_reference_corpus and its path, though the reference is now sample_corpus (the Keywords footer correctly reports 378 reference tokens).
Replay found the Order right sort not fully consistent for 'autonomous': two 'weapons .' lines were not adjacent.
